name: Historical Pandemic Trace
trigger_input: Optimize response for 21-day lockdown vs ICU capacity.

historical_steps.directive: Demands an aggressive 21-day hard lockdown of all schools and public transit to protect the 1,200 ICU bed limit.
Evaluates the $45M daily loss and high percentage of hourly workers. Vetoes the complete lockdown and amends the directive to a 30% transit capacity ceiling.
Flags that public cooperation will break by day 10 unless protective equipment is subsidized. Proposes distributing free mask sets at transit checkpoints.

payload.proposal: Distribute free mask sets at transit checkpoints

historical_steps.directive: Flags that current supplies will deplete in 7 days. Issues a Critical Override: Re-route daily transport logistics from the North Rail Terminal to rapidly restock checkpoint stations.

payload.critical_override: Re-route logistics from North Rail Terminal

historical_steps.directive: Evaluates childcare needs for medical workers. Amends school policy: Keep primary schools open, transition secondary to remote.

payload.policy_amendment: Keep primary schools open, Secondary schools remote
